elements.note: The item itself as a big cut-out photo (a person, cut out from their footage), from the shoulders down to the bottom edge and the full width. A thin light halo around the cut-out separates it from the background.

note: One ranked item = one big cut-out photo. The background is the same subject's footage, blurred and darkened, so its colours match the cut-out instead of fighting it. The number is said, not designed: the captions (big white words with a black outline) show "AT NUMBER" and then "1" on their own at the same spot, over the chest (second frame: item-03-b.webp).
